status: rules fixed before adaptive full validation runs

confidence.probe: same 32 uniform negatives already drawn; detached scores from current forward states
confidence.fraction: 0 through epoch 3; 0.5 * clamp(2*c-1,0,1) per target afterwards
confidence.note: relative score confidence, not calibrated interaction probability

rounding: floor(32*fraction+0.5), capped to leave at least one uniform slot
missing_text: replace requested semantic slots with existing uniform draws
selection: best all-user validation NDCG@10; no new test access until final selection
hypothesis: gradual or difficulty-dependent introduction may avoid fixed-mixture degradation; no guaranteed improvement
